critical_code_review_comments: routers/upcoming.py _date_items loads up to 5000 contacts and iterates DATE_FIELDS in Python for anniversary detection — fine for typical rep book (<1k contacts) but consider a Mongo aggregation with $expr on month/day if a rep ever has >5k contacts with birthdays/anniversaries.

routers/upcoming.py _send_items uses naive datetimes for send_at comparison (window_end.replace(tzinfo=None)) which matches the collection's naive storage — correct, but worth a comment because other routers (e.g. tasks) use aware UTC. Mixing conventions is a footgun for future work.

routers/upcoming.py get_upcoming clamps days via max(1,min(days,60)) BEFORE any validation of the type — FastAPI will coerce to int and 422 on non-int, but a negative like -5 becomes 1 silently. Not a bug (spec asks days=0 -> 1), just noting.

components/upcoming/UpcomingView.tsx load() swallows all errors with an empty catch and only sets data=null on non-quiet load; on quiet refresh (after send-now/cancel) a transient network blip is invisible to the user. Consider surfacing a toast.
